A notebook with no rules

A blank page can be a place to begin, without a plan.

Everyday wellbeing10 Oct 2026

A notebook does not need to become a project. It can hold a shopping list, a sentence you liked, a question, or a few words about your day.

Begin anywhere Write the date, something you noticed, or a thought you would like to return to. A single sentence counts as using the page.

Keep it yours There is no need to make it beautiful or consistent. Pick a format you enjoy, whether that is pen and paper or a note on your phone.

Return when you want Missing a day does not undo anything. Your notebook is there when it is useful to you.

From the Stillwell concept journal. Sample editorial content for this website preview, not personal clinical guidance.
